```html [Web Component]

</script>

<zw-form-field invalid
  ><zw-form-field-label>Email</zw-form-field-label
  ><zw-form-field-control><input type="email" /></zw-form-field-control

    >Enter a valid email.</zw-form-field-message
```

```tsx [React]
import {
  FormField,
  FormFieldControl,
  FormFieldLabel,
  FormFieldMessage,
} from '@zeus-web/form-field/react'

export function FormFieldExample() {
  return (
    <FormField invalid>
      <FormFieldLabel>Email</FormFieldLabel>
      <FormFieldControl>
        <input type="email" />
      </FormFieldControl>
      <FormFieldMessage>Enter a valid email.</FormFieldMessage>
    </FormField>
  )
}
```

## Add

```bash
zweb add form-field
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { FormField } from '@/components/ui/form-field'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { FormField } from '@zeus-web/form-field/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/form-field/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop       | Type      | Default | Description                               |
| ---------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`  | -       | Stable field identifier.                  |
| `invalid`  | `boolean` | -       | Marks the field as invalid.               |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | -       | Disables the associated control.          |
| `required` | `boolean` | -       | Marks the associated control as required. |

## Events

No public events documented.

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                                      |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `default` | Label, description, control and message content. |

## Examples

### React styled usage

```tsx
import {
  FormField,
  FormFieldControl,
  FormFieldLabel,
} from '@/components/ui/form-field'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <FormField required>
      <FormFieldLabel>Work email</FormFieldLabel>
      <FormFieldControl>
        <input type="email" />
      </FormFieldControl>
    </FormField>
  )
}
```
